family_transfer_contract.definition: project the state with normalization-invariant, energy-orthogonal projectors before evaluating the same positive band energy
family_transfer_contract.opposite_family_leakage: sum of arrival energies outside the declared target family indices
family_transfer_contract.partition_identity: target arrival + opposite-family leakage = total arrival
family_transfer_contract.target_arrival: sum of arrival energies in the declared target family indices

positive_transfer_contract.name: normalized_time_averaged_receiving_band_energy
positive_transfer_contract.normalization: the positive initial source-band energy computed on the same grid from the analytic reprojection
positive_transfer_contract.peak_companion: maximum receiving-band energy divided by initial source-band energy
positive_transfer_contract.primary_history: positive receiving-band total-energy history divided by initial source-band energy
positive_transfer_contract.reason_not_bounded: variable-background, descriptor, relaxation and lower-source work can amplify or attenuate stored packet energy
positive_transfer_contract.receiving_energy: E_receiving_total(t) = 1/2 sum_cells delta_p.T H delta_p Delta_lnR over fixed faces [6,49]

uncertainty_contract.combination: conservative deterministic sum or directly measured nuisance envelope; no root-sum-square without demonstrated independence
uncertainty_contract.direction_cosine_binding_rule: both refinement-error norms must exceed the frozen uncertainty envelope by the observability factor
